blocks.text: Jab macrophages hamla awar jaraseem par hamla karte hain to pyrogens naam ke kimiyai maadde chhorte hain. Yeh khoon ke zariye dimagh mein hypothalamus, jism ke thermostat, tak pohanch kar use jism ki andaruni hararat maamool ke 37 C (98.6 F) se oopar karne par aamada karte hain. Maamool se zyada hararat bukhar (pyrexia) hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar dabbe: macrophages jaraseem par hamla karte; woh khoon mein pyrogens chhorte; hypothalamus, jism ka thermostat, set point barhata; 37 C (98.6 F) se oopar bukhar. Neeche dabba bukhar ke asraat aur khatarnak darje batata hai.
blocks.caption: Bukhar kaise shuru hota aur kya karta hai (is topic ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Jab macrophages hamla awar jaraseem par hamla karte hain to pyrogens chhorte hain jo khoon ke zariye hypothalamus, jism ke thermostat, tak ja kar use andaruni hararat maamool ke 37 C (98.6 F) se oopar karne par aamada karte hain: bukhar ya pyrexia. Bukhar bacteria aur viruses ki afzaish rokta, kuch hararat se hassas jaraseem maarta, neutrophils aur macrophages ko tez karta aur interferons jaise cytokines zyada chhurwata hai. Taqreeban 103 F (39.4 C) se oopar khatarnak aur taqreeban 105 F (40.5 C) se oopar aksar jaan lewa samjha jata hai.

items: Bukhar bacteria aur viruses ki afzaish rokta hai.
Kuch hararat se hassas jaraseem, jaise Streptococcus pneumoniae aur influenza virus, tez bukhar mein mar jate hain.
Bukhar neutrophils aur macrophages ka kaam tez karta hai.
Bukhar mein jism zyada cytokines (interferons) chhorta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat: bukhar kab khatarnak hai
blocks.text: Aam taur par 103 F (39.4 C) se oopar hararat khatarnak aur 105 F (40.5 C) se oopar aksar jaan lewa samjhi jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Macrophage se bukhar tak ka raasta batayein.
blocks.explanation: Jaraseem par hamla karte macrophages pyrogens chhorte; yeh khoon se hypothalamus tak pohanchte; hypothalamus jism ki muqarrar hararat barhata aur bukhar hota hai.

items: Macrophages ke pyrogens hypothalamus ko 37 C se oopar set karte.
Bukhar jaraseem dheemi aur phagocytes tez karta; 103 F se oopar khatarnak, 105 F se oopar aksar jaan lewa.
